meta.name: advise-project-approach
meta.description: Research and advise on the best way to approach a software project, including architecture, tech stack, implementation strategy, pricing/operating-cost tradeoffs, benchmark research, and comparisons with similar real-world projects. Use before building, mid-build, or after completion when the user asks for project strategy, optimal approach, research comparables, similar projects, stack selection, vendor/service choice, repo analysis, architecture critique, implementation feedback, or a prioritized improvement plan. Avoid for narrow single-bug debugging or isolated file edits unless the user asks for broader project direction.

copy.tagline: 分析项目并给出架构、技术栈和实施策略建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在构建或重构软件项目时需要专业方向建议
copy.tagline_en: Analyze projects and advise on architecture, tech stack, and implementation strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need expert guidance on software project direction, architecture, or tech stack decisions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的软件项目目标、现有代码或描述，研究类似项目和技术方案，然后给出架构、技术栈、实现策略、成本权衡等方面的建议。
howto.when: 当你询问项目策略、最佳方法、技术选型、架构评审或改进计划时触发。适用于项目开始前、开发中或完成后。

say.text: 帮我分析这个项目的技术栈选择。
say.note: Claude 会评估你的项目并推荐合适的技术栈。

say.text: 对比一下这个项目与类似项目的架构。
say.note: Claude 会研究可比项目并给出对比分析。

say.text: 我的项目快完成了，帮我做一次全面审查。
say.note: Claude 会进行后构建审查，包括架构、质量、部署准备等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your software project goal, existing code or description, research comparable projects and tech options, then provide advice on architecture, tech stack, implementation strategy, and cost tradeoffs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about project strategy, optimal approach, tech selection, architecture review, or improvement plan. Works before building, mid-build, or after completion.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the tech stack for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate your project and recommend a suitable tech stack.

say_en.text: Compare this project's architecture with similar projects.
say_en.note: Claude will research comparable projects and provide a comparison.

say_en.text: My project is almost done, do a comprehensive review.
